I am writing to formally submit my candidacy for the position of Fifth Presidential Face at the Mount Rushmore National Memorial, as authorized under the referenced vacancy announcement. Having carefully reviewed the qualification standards, I am confident that my background aligns with the requirements set forth by the National Park Service (NPS) and the Department of the Interior.

**Summary of Qualifications**

As you will observe from my enclosed resume, I possess the demonstrated capacity for the sustained, weather-resistant public service that this appointment demands. I am prepared to maintain a fixed and dignified expression across all four seasons, in accordance with the standards of granite comportment historically upheld at this site. I further understand that this is a permanent, non-relocatable, full-time position with no opportunity for telework.

**Relevant Experience**

- Extensive experience remaining motionless for extended periods, frequently exceeding a standard eight-hour tour of duty.
